captures.description: 'New Human Press is an independent publisher noted for its avant-garde and experimental poetry, literary theory, and digital-philosophy works' (cites Zenodo +3) — accompanied by the Whitman-riding-velociraptor image (the LOGOS* avatar from across the archive). Expanded: 'Their publications typically explore themes of the platform economy, immanent phenomenology, and posthumanist poetics. Key titles and resources include' (National Institutes... +1): 'Autonomous Semantic Warfare — A field manual by Rex Fraction that explores meaning in the age of algorithmic platforms, available on Amazon'; 'Pearl and Other Poems — A foundational poetry collection by Lee Sharks, cataloged in literature archives and available via Barnes & Noble.' Closing prompt: 'Are you searching for a specific title by the publisher?' Below: Espresso Media 'The New Human' (junk — adjacent domain) and The New Press 'Human Rights Archives' (junk — different publisher entirely). The composition layer ties Rex Fraction (heteronym) and Lee Sharks together under New Human Press as named authors, with Pearl and Other Poems (PH-01) attributed correctly to Lee. The Whitman-on-velociraptor image surfaces here as the publisher's sigil.
